thread:
sofia: heads up 1: our onboarding starter app broke on bun and deno after the export map change. Node (cjs/esm) looks OK but a few CI jobs for alternative runtimes failed.
ryan: ouch. any logs?
sofia: bun error is `Cannot find package 'redwood-sdk'` during require/import. deno build fails with 'package resolution error: package does not provide an entry point for this import' when using npm: specifier.
tom: Bun/Deno/Edge all do slightly different resolution. Did we remove the root entry? I remember the map only exposing subpaths.
sofia: yep. current exports are basically "./client" and "./server" only. no root. many examples import the package root.
priya: we caught one more downstream: some monorepo setups (pnpm + hoisting) fall back to reading package.json from the package root (`./package.json`) and that was blocked by the strict map, so lockfile installs produced odd runtime errors in integration tests.
ryan: that explains flaky integ tests. solution options?
tom: short-term: add a permissive root export that covers node, browser, and worker-ish targets, plus expose `./package.json` and types. something like:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
    "default": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
  },
  "./*": "./dist/*",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
priya: also propose adding a dedicated `deno` entry in our packaging (we can ship a small `dist/deno/mod.ts` that re-exports ESM builds) since Deno sometimes prefers file-based entry points.
sofia: we should avoid a big compatibility shim. can we instead add a lightweight `redwood-compat` alias in sample apps that points to specific subpaths? But that won't help third-party users who import root directly.
ryan: I vote for fixing the SDK package as the canonical fix. Add root + types + package.json export. Then update sample apps to import explicit subpaths where appropriate.
tom: addendum: ensure `package.json` still has `main` and `module` fields to help older bundlers and some CDNs. while exports map is authoritative, many tools still read those fields.
priya: testing plan: add a small matrix job to sample-apps CI that runs vscode-esm lint, bun run build, deno bundle, and an esbuild+wrangler smoke test (cloudflare worker-like). that'll catch these resolve regressions early.
sofia: I'll open packaging PR with root export + package.json pointer + types. will also add compatibility note in the changelog.
devx-bot: ACTIONS: (1) sofia -> open packaging PR (2) priya -> add CI matrix job to sample-apps (3) tom -> add lint rule to check exports map includes "." and "./package.json" (4) ryan -> coordinate a canary publish to the staging registry and run bun/deno smoke tests.
sofia: thanks team. ping me if you see any other weird resolver edgecases (e.g. .mjs vs .js ext differences or "type":"module" interplay).
